bar: joyful / obvious / frictionless vs WhatsApp & Slack

rubric.joyful: Warm, human, celebrates progress; list sells conversation not filenames; empty states inviting (0–100 vs WhatsApp/Slack).
rubric.obvious: Know where you are, who's here, what to do next; labels not mystery icons; links land where names promise — no misroutes (0–100).
rubric.frictionless: No full-page splash for in-app moves; phone works; one path to common actions; no dead ends (0–100).

headline.note: Equal-weight across surfaces. Website now measured (65 overall).

honesty.provisional_from_evidence: Derived from Coverage L2 fails/misroutes, finance visual review notes, known P0 defects — labeled in plain English per surface.
honesty.unscored: Prefer provisional with low confidence over blank if L2 touched the hub.

surfaces.name: Team chat
surfaces.plainSummary: Measured Sep 1 Instructor Circle QA vs WhatsApp/Slack. Good bones (channel groups, warm reactions, Catch me up idea) but Refrm leak under Bluebird, phone thread unusable, no DMs/@mentions, and full-page splash on every open. Not yet a joyful or frictionless team chat.
strengths: GENERAL / LOCATIONS / ROLES grouping matches how studios think
Warm reaction strip; poll results visible without voting
In-chat search is instant and correctly scoped
Catch me up concept is delightful — just unlabeled

findings.title: Tenant isolation — Refrm chat under Bluebird
findings.detail: Bluebird shell still shows Refrm channels, staff names, polls and files. Teacher/client ignore ?c= for chat.
findings.suggestion: Scope channel/message/poll/file queries by company id server-side; reject unauthorized ?c=; fix document title/branding.

findings.title: Who's here / Catch me up hidden
findings.detail: No avatar stack or member count in header; sparkle icon unlabeled so Catch me up looks like decoration.
findings.suggestion: Avatar stack + count in header; label Catch me up as a real button.

findings.title: No @mention, no composer emoji, no link previews
findings.detail: Typing @ does nothing; emoji only as reactions; Mentions-only notifications are dead.
findings.suggestion: Add @mention picker, composer emoji, and basic link previews.

findings.title: Locked channel writable; Groups empty
findings.detail: Padlock icon on a channel that still accepts typing; Groups shows skeletons then zero with no create affordance.
findings.suggestion: Enforce lock or drop the icon; empty Groups state with next action.

findings.title: Polls tab empty while live poll exists
findings.detail: Named Polls home shows No polls yet while a live poll sits in-channel.
findings.suggestion: Aggregate channel polls into the Polls tab.

findings.title: People search blank; no DMs
findings.detail: Search channels or people returns blank for people; no 1:1 path — private talk stays on WhatsApp.
findings.suggestion: People results + DM / New message path.

findings.title: Unread / presence / Priority unclear
findings.detail: Priority only undefined; presence has no visible payoff; unread counts disagree across surfaces.
findings.suggestion: Define Priority; show presence dots; reconcile unread badges.

findings.title: Full-screen splash; filter chips sticky
findings.detail: HelgoIQ splash + Loading messages for in-app channel opens; filter chips can both look active.
findings.suggestion: In-place skeleton; never leave chat shell; reliable chip state.

findings.title: Phone thread unscrolled; list clipped; no studio switcher
findings.detail: At 390×844 message column ~2440px with overflow hidden — composer off-screen. Timestamps/unread clipped. No company switcher on phone.
findings.suggestion: min-h-0 + overflow-y:auto on scroller; mobile-first list; studio switcher in phone chrome.

suggestions: Make channel list WhatsApp-like: avatar + last message + bold unread
Header answers who's here (avatar stack + count)
Kill full-page splash for in-chat moves — skeleton in place
Ship DMs and a working @mention picker
Fix phone thread scroll (min-h-0) before any polish
Close F001 tenant scope before any write testing
